summary: Injured climber (knee injury and twisted ankle) stranded with a companion on a ridge near Maroon Peak, out of food and water and severely dehydrated; both spent the night out. Mountain Rescue Aspen and Lifeguard 2 helicopter rescued them Saturday morning; injured climber flown to Aspen Valley Hospital
location: Maroon Peak (14,163 ft), ~12 mi southwest of Aspen
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Lifeguard 2; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office press release quoted in SnowBrains article: call received ~11:00 p.m. Friday Aug 25, 2017 via satellite phone from a friend of the pair; deputy planned rescue with Mountain Rescue Aspen at 6:30 a.m. Saturday; Lifeguard 2 out of Frisco landed near the climber. Two climbers stranded; one injured (knee/ankle, dehydrated).
